purpose: Deterministic scripted fixtures F1..F12 (plus concrete subcases F4b/F9b, which are NOT registered as F13/F14; fixture_family_count stays 12) for the G2-03 minimal parallel DES. All real states and observations are scripted (no RNG). Acceptance values are test oracles / fixture timelines, NOT formal competition numbers.
v102_rebind_note: V1.0.2 rebind: F3 reworked to B first-failure (T=8->7); F4 restored to the t*=7.5 cross-device same-tick PASS (old unreachable NOTE deleted); F4b cancellation subcase added; F7/F9/F10 fixed to batch=3/preloaded=[1,2] (SEM-21); F9b SEM-23 concurrent-transport subcase added; D is materialized in the E2 substep (A/B/C all-PASS timestamp, before the E TASK_RELEASE, never at the E ACTIVITY_START).
k9_authoritative_note: F8 binds event-by-event to the K9 hand timeline; T=14h, S=3, PL=0, PW=0, YXB_A=7.5/18, YXB_B=8/18, YXB_C=7.5/18, YXB_E=9/18. YXB values are stored below as reduced fractions (7.5/18=15/36=5/12, 8/18=4/9, 9/18=1/2). fixtures.name: 单装置 A/B/C 同刻并行
fixtures.description: One device, all PASS: A/B/C start at t=0 in parallel, B finishes 2.0, A/C finish 2.5, E runs 2.5..5.5, device passes at 5.5. Last device: no turnover.

key_assertions: A/B/C all start at t=0 (true parallelism)
B completes at 2.0; A and C complete at 2.5
E starts at 2.5 and completes at 5.5
no TURNOVER_* events (last device not transported out)
SIMULATION_END at 5.5

fixtures.name: 双装置资源竞争 + FCFS
fixtures.description: Two devices, both preloaded, all PASS. A/B/C/E capacity 1; on every resource the device with the smaller device_id is dispatched first (FCFS key tie broken by device_id).

key_assertions: device1 A/B/C start at 0; device2 A starts at 2.5, device2 B at 2.0, device2 C at 2.5 (capacity 1)
device2 E starts at 5.5 (after device1 E 2.5..5.5)
same resource: smaller device_id dispatched first
no self-overlap of the same process
